# KHM Tutoring

> Personalized K-12 tutoring in Honolulu and online throughout Hawaii, founded in 2016.

## About

KHM Tutoring is a Honolulu-based K-12 tutoring service founded in 2016. The company provides personalized one-on-one tutoring in math, English, SAT and SSAT preparation, AP subjects, and college essay support. In-person sessions are available across the Honolulu corridor; online tutoring is available throughout Hawaii. Families can begin with a free consultation and diagnostic.

## Free Diagnostic Test

KHM Tutoring offers a free, no-login academic diagnostic test at https://www.khmtutoring.com/diagnostic-test. The test takes 15-70 minutes and covers grade-appropriate topics for Elementary (K-5), Middle School (6-8), or High School (9-12) in Math or English. After completing the test, parents receive a personalized topic-by-topic breakdown by email along with an invitation for a free tutoring consultation. Results are confidential and the test is available to all families regardless of whether they become customers.

## Group SAT Prep Program

KHM Tutoring offers a small-cohort SAT prep program at https://www.khmtutoring.com/group-sat-prep. Cohorts of 6-8 students are organized by level, readiness, and schedule. The program is 20 hours of live instruction covering SAT content, timing, strategy, and pattern recognition. Three schedule windows are available: Sunday mornings, weekday after-school, and weekday evenings. Sessions begin January 5, 2027. Students submit a fit form to be placed in the right cohort.

## Services

- Math Tutoring (arithmetic through AP Calculus)
- English Tutoring (reading comprehension, essay writing, grammar, vocabulary)
- SAT Prep (Digital SAT content, adaptive strategy, timing, and practice review)
- SSAT Prep (private school admissions test preparation)
- AP Subject Tutoring (Advanced Placement exam preparation)
- College Counseling & Essay Writing (applications, admissions consulting)
- Group SAT Prep (small cohorts of 6-8 students, 20 hours, strategy-focused)
- Online Tutoring (via Zoom for all of Hawaii)
- In-Store Tutoring (Kakaʻako space with Surfers Coffee Hawaiʻi – Kakaʻako)
- In-Person Tutoring (Honolulu corridor, Pearl City to Hawaiʻi Kai; ʻEwa reachable but outside the ideal area)

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2016 by Kody Kim
- Service area: In person in Honolulu (Pearl City to Hawaiʻi Kai); online across all of Hawaii
- Delivery: In-store in Kakaʻako, in-home/meet-up in Honolulu, or online via Zoom statewide
- Hours: Daily after 3 PM (by appointment)
- Space: Surfers Coffee Kakaʻako is open to the public until 2 PM. After that, KHM students and their families use the space for tutoring.
- Free initial consultation available
- Not a franchise -- locally owned and operated
- Specialized in Hawaii private school prep (Punahou, Iolani)
